subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable shape should replace inline per-session `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and session compatibility?
rationale: The remaining fix is not only mechanical: current source intentionally persists the report for warning dedupe, while field data shows the full report now dominates session-store size.

options.title: Persist minimal report state
options.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe state in session rows and make bulky report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

options.title: Out-of-line report blobs
options.body: Move large report payloads to content-addressed storage similar to skill prompts, with session rows keeping compact refs.

options.title: Retain inline reports
options.body: Keep the current inline design and rely on pruning/capping, accepting continued duplicated metadata in retained rows.

recommendation.title: Persist minimal report state
recommendation.body: Store only the small warning-dedupe state in session rows and make bulky report sections recomputable or diagnostic-only.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the prompt-report feature and authored the adjacent prompt-blob mitigation, making him the best available routing owner for the storage-policy choice.
